description: Materials Project Data is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS, a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "infrastructure, energy", published or maintained by Materials Project. Materials Project is an open database of computed materials properties aiming to accelerate materials science research. The resources in this OpenData dataset contain the raw, parsed, and build data products. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tags infrastructure, energy and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: New versions and objects added as we continuously calculate, parse and build new materials and their properties. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is stated as "Materials Project Terms of Use" on the registry page. Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws.
